scope: Ordinary Files routes, actual signed workspace identities, persisted packaged assets and protected shares in owned offset700 sandbox.

checks.name: Ordinary bulk move reports actual partial collision
Bulk Keep both resolves the real destination collision
Ordinary drag move changes actual file destination
Archive makes the actual file unavailable to active reads
Ordinary restore returns the same actual record and saved version
Ordinary upload request creates actual protected capability
Public request uses real password/cookie exchange and clears URL secret
Anonymous capability submits a real packaged file once
Ordinary revoke invalidates actual request capability
No unexpected browser runtime or console errors
